VD-001.title: Recover abandoned carts in conversation
VD-001.what_it_does: When a shopper leaves a cart, the agent messages them about what they left and answers the doubts on shipping, returns or sizing. It offers only the incentive you approved and writes the recovered order back to your store platform.
VD-001.first_step: Export a week of abandoned carts and list the reasons shoppers give most.

VD-002.title: Answer where-is-my-order on every channel
VD-002.what_it_does: The agent confirms who is asking, reads live status from your order system and carrier, and settles routine cases itself. Address changes and reschedules follow your policy, and real exceptions reach a person.
VD-002.first_step: Count last month's status calls and sort them by the question asked.

VD-003.title: Run returns and exchanges end to end
VD-003.what_it_does: The agent explains your returns policy, checks the order is eligible and creates the return label. It books the pickup where your carrier supports it and updates the order and helpdesk ticket.
VD-003.first_step: Write your returns rules as plain yes or no questions the agent can check.

VD-004.title: Advise shoppers and close the sale
VD-004.what_it_does: When a shopper calls or messages, the agent answers from your catalogue, compares options and checks live stock. It applies your promotion rules and sends a checkout link or holds the item.
VD-004.first_step: Pick your ten most-asked product questions and write the approved answers.

VD-005.title: Book delivery and installation slots
VD-005.what_it_does: After a big-ticket purchase the agent contacts the buyer and books a delivery and installation slot against your carrier and installer calendars. It sends confirmations and day-of arrival updates, and reschedules on request.
VD-005.first_step: List the products that need installation and the slot rules for each.

VD-006.title: Compare products and reserve stock
VD-006.what_it_does: The agent handles calls and chats on specs, compatibility and price, then checks stock across stores and the warehouse. It reserves the item or books a store visit and logs the lead for follow-up.
VD-006.first_step: Share your top selling models with the questions buyers ask before choosing.

VD-007.title: Offer extended warranty after purchase
VD-007.what_it_does: After a qualifying purchase the agent contacts the customer with a warranty or accessory offer you approved. It answers coverage questions, takes the add-on and records it against the order.
VD-007.first_step: Decide which products qualify for an offer and write the approved wording.

VD-008.title: Triage warranty and setup questions
VD-008.what_it_does: The agent walks customers through first-line setup and defect checks, then confirms warranty status in your system. It books a repair or replacement under policy and files a full ticket when a person must step in.
VD-008.first_step: Collect the ten setup or defect issues that fill your support queue.

VD-013.title: Reply to every internet lead in a minute
VD-013.what_it_does: The agent answers each web and phone lead straight away, asks about budget, model and trade-in, and checks inventory. It books a showroom or test-drive slot and writes the full record into your CRM.
VD-013.first_step: Pull last month's internet leads and measure how long the first reply took.

VD-014.title: Answer the service line and book slots
VD-014.what_it_does: The agent covers overflow and after-hours calls, books service slots against shop capacity and quotes your menu prices. It confirms recall or warranty cover and writes the booking into your scheduler.
VD-014.first_step: Count calls to the service line that went unanswered last week.

VD-015.title: Push repair status and pickup updates
VD-015.what_it_does: The agent sends an update at each stage of the repair order and collects approvals for extra work with photos and estimates. It then schedules the pickup, so customers stop calling to ask.
VD-015.first_step: List the repair order stages you want customers to hear about.

VD-016.title: Call owners about due service and recalls
VD-016.what_it_does: The agent works through your owner list for due maintenance, open recalls and repairs customers declined earlier. It handles objections, books the visit into your scheduler and logs the result.
VD-016.first_step: Export owners with service due or recalls open and rank them by last visit.

VD-017.title: Capture every missed call and book it
VD-017.what_it_does: The agent answers calls the counter misses, collects the vehicle and fault, gives menu prices and books the slot in your shop calendar. It texts a confirmation with directions.
VD-017.first_step: Note how many calls go unanswered at your busiest hour.

VD-018.title: Remind customers and stop no-shows
VD-018.what_it_does: Each booking gets several reminders with a one-tap confirm or reschedule. Cancelled slots are offered to a waiting list, and doubtful cases go to the service advisor.
VD-018.first_step: Check your no-show rate for the last month and the slots it left empty.

VD-019.title: Get estimates approved over WhatsApp
VD-019.what_it_does: The agent sends the inspection and estimate, answers questions on each line and records approve or decline. It then sends the pickup-ready message and updates the job card.
VD-019.first_step: Choose one estimate type to send digitally first, such as brakes or tyres.

VD-020.title: Win back overdue and seasonal customers
VD-020.what_it_does: The agent works your service history for cars overdue for maintenance or seasonal work, quotes the price and books the visit. Outcomes go back into your customer records.
VD-020.first_step: Export customers with no visit in the last year and group them by service due.

VD-025.title: Take maintenance requests and dispatch
VD-025.what_it_does: The agent takes maintenance calls and messages at any hour, separates emergencies from routine jobs under your policy and collects photos and access notes. It creates the work order, sends the right vendor and keeps the tenant updated.
VD-025.first_step: Write your emergency versus routine rules as a short checklist.

VD-026.title: Answer rental enquiries and book tours
VD-026.what_it_does: The agent replies to each rental enquiry instantly, asks about budget, move-in date and pets, and quotes rent and fees. It books a tour and sends the application link, which shortens vacancy.
VD-026.first_step: Review how long your last ten enquiries waited for a first reply.

VD-027.title: Triage emergencies after hours
VD-027.what_it_does: At night and on weekends the agent runs a short diagnostic for floods, no heat or lockouts. It sends the on-call vendor under your protocol, records everything and leaves non-urgent issues for the morning.
VD-027.first_step: List your on-call vendors and the emergency types each one covers.

VD-028.title: Remind tenants and follow up on rent
VD-028.what_it_does: The agent sends polite reminders with payment links before the due date and escalates past-due outreach under your policy. It records promises to pay and passes payment plan requests to a manager.
VD-028.first_step: Write the reminder sequence you use today and the point it escalates.

VD-029.title: Answer reservation calls and close the booking
VD-029.what_it_does: The agent answers every call and message with live rates and availability, completes the booking with payment and handles changes. It suggests room upgrades, turning travel-site guests into direct bookings.
VD-029.first_step: Count reservation calls missed last month and the average booking value.

VD-030.title: Sell upgrades before guests arrive
VD-030.what_it_does: Before arrival the agent contacts confirmed guests with offers for upgrades, dining, late checkout or transfers. It takes the purchase and posts the charge to the guest folio.
VD-030.first_step: List the add-ons guests ask for most and their prices.

VD-031.title: Handle in-stay requests as a concierge
VD-031.what_it_does: The agent takes housekeeping, amenity and complaint requests on WhatsApp or voice at any hour. It routes each job to the right department and confirms completion with the guest.
VD-031.first_step: Map the ten most common guest requests to the team that owns each.

VD-032.title: Qualify group and event enquiries
VD-032.what_it_does: The agent takes event enquiries instantly, captures dates, headcount and budget, and checks function space. It sends your capability deck and books a site visit, logging the full qualification.
VD-032.first_step: Prepare the questions your sales team always asks on a group enquiry.

VD-033.title: Take reservations and phone orders
VD-033.what_it_does: During the rush and after hours the agent books and changes reservations against your floor plan. It takes pickup and delivery orders from the menu, sends payment links and syncs with your till.
VD-033.first_step: Record how many calls go unanswered during one weekend service.

VD-034.title: Confirm bookings and refill empty tables
VD-034.what_it_does: Every booking is confirmed the day before with an easy cancel or reschedule. Freed tables are offered to the waiting list straight away.
VD-034.first_step: Check last month's cancellations and how many tables stayed empty.

VD-035.title: Qualify private event and catering requests
VD-035.what_it_does: The agent handles large-party, buyout and catering enquiries, capturing date, headcount and budget. It shares menus and packages, books tastings and keeps following up on proposals.
VD-035.first_step: List your event packages and the minimum spend for each.

VD-036.title: Answer trip enquiries and book consultations
VD-036.what_it_does: The agent replies to every trip enquiry in minutes, asks about destination, dates, budget and party size and shares sample itineraries. It books a specialist consultation and keeps undecided travellers warm.
VD-036.first_step: Measure how long trip enquiries wait for a first reply today.

VD-037.title: Chase quotes until they close
VD-037.what_it_does: Every open quote gets steady follow-up. The agent answers questions, handles price objections within your rules, points out limited availability and closes with a payment link or a handover to an agent.
VD-037.first_step: List open quotes older than a week with the last contact date.

VD-038.title: Chase passports, balances and documents
VD-038.what_it_does: The agent chases unpaid balances, passport details, waivers and visa papers ahead of each departure date. It collects uploads, checks they are complete and flags exceptions to your agents.
VD-038.first_step: Write the document checklist for your most booked trip type.

VD-039.title: Respond to event enquiries instantly
VD-039.what_it_does: The agent captures date, headcount, event type and budget, checks your calendar and sends packages and floor plans. It books site tours with full notes in your CRM.
VD-039.first_step: Gather your packages, capacity limits and the calendar the agent should read.

VD-040.title: Follow up proposals and manage date holds
VD-040.what_it_does: The agent follows up every proposal, answers questions and handles menu or price revisions. It reminds clients before a date hold expires and chases the signed contract and deposit.
VD-040.first_step: List active date holds and when each one expires.

VD-041.title: Collect final details before each event
VD-041.what_it_does: The agent confirms final headcounts, menus and timings with clients and chases vendor confirmations. Updated event orders go to the team, ending the email chase before each event.
VD-041.first_step: Take one upcoming event and list every confirmation you chase for it.

VD-042.title: Remind patients and refill cancelled slots
VD-042.what_it_does: Patients get tiered reminders with one-tap confirm or reschedule, and cancelled slots go to the waiting list at once. Every change lands in your practice scheduler.
VD-042.first_step: Pull last month's missed appointments and the revenue each slot carried.

VD-043.title: Answer front desk calls and book visits
VD-043.what_it_does: The agent answers every call, books, moves or cancels appointments and handles insurance and preparation questions. Clinical questions go to triage, and after-hours demand is captured instead of lost to voicemail.
VD-043.first_step: Log the top five reasons patients call the front desk.

VD-044.title: Recall overdue patients and book them
VD-044.what_it_does: The agent works your recall list for overdue annual visits, follow-ups and screenings. It talks through patients' barriers, books straight into the schedule and records the outcome.
VD-044.first_step: Export patients overdue for a visit and sort them by how long.

VD-045.title: Take refill requests and route them
VD-045.what_it_does: The agent verifies the patient, collects the pharmacy and medication details and queues the request for provider approval. The patient hears back when it is done, taking pressure off the main call driver.
VD-045.first_step: Count refill requests per week and who approves them.

VD-046.title: Capture missed new-patient calls
VD-046.what_it_does: The agent answers missed, overflow and after-hours calls, collects new-patient details and insurance and books hygiene or exam slots. It texts a confirmation, rescuing callers who never leave voicemail.
VD-046.first_step: Check how many new-patient calls went unanswered last week.

VD-047.title: Prevent no-shows and refill chairs
VD-047.what_it_does: Each appointment gets a confirmation sequence, likely no-shows are flagged and rescheduling is offered at once. Openings are filled from an as-soon-as-possible list.
VD-047.first_step: Work out what an empty chair hour costs you and how many you lose a month.

VD-048.title: Recall hygiene and unscheduled treatment
VD-048.what_it_does: The agent works recall lists and unscheduled treatment plans, answers cost and insurance questions and books the visit. Conversion per campaign is tracked in your practice system.
VD-048.first_step: Export patients overdue for hygiene and open treatment plans not yet booked.

VD-049.title: Answer insurance and billing questions
VD-049.what_it_does: The agent answers coverage basics, balances, opening hours, directions and forms, reading balances from your system where allowed. Only true exceptions go to your staff.
VD-049.first_step: List the questions your front desk answers most about insurance and bills.

VD-050.title: Book visits and catch missed calls
VD-050.what_it_does: The agent answers calls missed during appointments and surgery, books wellness visits and notes urgent cases for a triage callback. It takes refill requests and confirms by text.
VD-050.first_step: Count calls missed during surgery hours in a normal week.

VD-051.title: Remind owners about vaccines and checks
VD-051.what_it_does: The agent runs your recall calendar for vaccines, dental work, senior panels and parasite prevention. Owners book directly into the schedule and compliance is tracked per pet.
VD-051.first_step: Export pets overdue for a vaccine and rank them by how long.

VD-052.title: Take refill and food-order requests
VD-052.what_it_does: The agent confirms the pet and medication, queues the request for the vet's approval and tells the owner when it is ready with a payment or pickup link. It answers routine status questions.
VD-052.first_step: List the medications and foods owners reorder most often.

VD-053.title: Check in after surgery and discharge
VD-053.what_it_does: The agent runs scheduled check-ins after surgery, dental work or illness visits, confirms recovery milestones and answers common aftercare questions. Worrying answers go to the care team and outcomes are logged.
VD-053.first_step: Write the aftercare questions your nurses ask on a follow-up call.

VD-054.title: Book consultations and capture missed calls
VD-054.what_it_does: The agent answers every enquiry instantly, asks about the treatment and budget and books consultations against provider schedules. It takes deposits under your policy and confirms automatically.
VD-054.first_step: Count missed enquiries over a week and what a consultation is worth.

VD-055.title: Stop no-shows and refill cancelled slots
VD-055.what_it_does: Reminders go out in several touches with a one-tap confirm or reschedule, and the deposit and cancellation policy is restated. Cancellations are offered to the waiting list straight away.
VD-055.first_step: Review last month's no-shows and the provider hours they cost.

VD-056.title: Win back lapsed clients and open plans
VD-056.what_it_does: The agent works the lapsed-client list and unbooked treatment plans with outreach that refers to past treatments. It answers questions, applies the offers you approved and books the appointment.
VD-056.first_step: Export clients with no visit for several months and any unbooked plans.

VD-057.title: Follow up aftercare and ask for reviews
VD-057.what_it_does: The agent sends structured check-ins in the days after a treatment, answers common recovery questions and escalates concerns to providers. It asks happy clients for a public review at the right moment.
VD-057.first_step: Write the aftercare check-in questions for your most common treatment.

VD-058.title: Book appointments around the clock
VD-058.what_it_does: The agent answers every call and message, books services against stylist or therapist calendars and handles reschedules. It takes deposits for high-value services and sends preparation notes.
VD-058.first_step: Check how many booking requests arrive outside opening hours.

VD-059.title: Defend against late cancellations
VD-059.what_it_does: Confirmation sequences come with one-tap rescheduling, and cards or deposits are collected under your policy. Freed slots are offered to the waiting list immediately.
VD-059.first_step: Note how many last-minute cancellations you had last month and their value.

VD-060.title: Rebook clients and win back lapsed ones
VD-060.what_it_does: Clients are prompted to rebook before they leave or by message afterwards. The agent works lapse lists with personal outreach and fills quiet days with offers for regulars.
VD-060.first_step: List clients who normally visit regularly and have not returned.

VD-061.title: Recommend products and sell gift cards
VD-061.what_it_does: After a visit the agent recommends the products used and promotes gift cards in seasonal campaigns. Purchases are completed through a payment link.
VD-061.first_step: Pick the top five retail products and write why clients choose them.

VD-062.title: Call trial leads within minutes
VD-062.what_it_does: The agent contacts each trial-pass or web lead quickly, asks about goals and schedule and books a tour or first session. It keeps following up until it reaches the person.
VD-062.first_step: Time how long trial leads wait for a first call today.

VD-063.title: Confirm trials and release unused spots
VD-063.what_it_does: Tours, trial sessions and class bookings get reminder sequences with an easy reschedule. Unconfirmed spots are released to the waiting list so capacity does not sit empty.
VD-063.first_step: Review trial no-show rate and class spots left empty last month.

VD-064.title: Answer class and membership questions
VD-064.what_it_does: The agent answers class times, pricing tiers, freeze rules and guest passes. It also handles simple actions such as class bookings and freeze requests under your membership rules.
VD-064.first_step: List the questions your front desk answers every day.

VD-065.title: Talk members through cancellation and freezes
VD-065.what_it_does: When a member asks to cancel or freeze, the agent finds the reason and presents the save offers you approved, such as a freeze, a downgrade or a training session. It processes the choice and records why people leave.
VD-065.first_step: Write your save offers and the rule for when each applies.

VD-066.title: Answer family enquiries and book assessments
VD-066.what_it_does: The agent answers each family enquiry within minutes, gently captures care needs, location, hours and payment type, and books an in-home assessment. It keeps in touch with families who are still deciding.
VD-066.first_step: Review how long recent family enquiries waited for a reply.

VD-067.title: Cover caregiver call-outs fast
VD-067.what_it_does: When a caregiver calls out, the agent works your availability list by phone or text, offers the shift and confirms who accepts. It updates the schedule and tells the family.
VD-067.first_step: Document the steps your coordinator follows when a shift is uncovered.

VD-068.title: Screen caregiver applicants the same day
VD-068.what_it_does: The agent speaks to every applicant the day they apply, checks credentials, experience and availability and scores them against your needs. It books interviews and keeps candidates warm until their start date.
VD-068.first_step: Write your must-have criteria for a caregiver role.

VD-069.title: Make wellness and family update calls
VD-069.what_it_does: The agent makes scheduled wellness checks and family update calls from your care-plan script and captures concerns in conversation. Flagged issues go to care managers and every call is documented.
VD-069.first_step: Choose one client group and write the standard check-in questions.

VD-070.title: Contact quote leads within a minute
VD-070.what_it_does: The agent contacts every web or purchased lead at once, asks about coverage needs, current carrier, renewal date and risks and books an agent appointment or transfers the call live. Everything is logged in your system.
VD-070.first_step: Measure how long quote leads wait for contact today.

VD-071.title: Run renewal outreach and stop lapses
VD-071.what_it_does: The agent works your renewal calendar ahead of each date, captures changes in risk and queues requotes. It chases unsigned documents and payments and escalates at-risk accounts to producers.
VD-071.first_step: Export renewals due in the next quarter by value.

VD-072.title: Handle certificates, ID cards and changes
VD-072.what_it_does: The agent confirms identity, issues certificates and auto ID cards from your templates and logs changes for processing. It confirms completion to the client.
VD-072.first_step: Count routine service requests per week and the types that repeat.

VD-073.title: Take loss reports and update claimants
VD-073.what_it_does: The agent takes loss reports at any hour, guides the claimant through structured questions and collects photos and papers. It opens the claim with the insurer and sends status updates.
VD-073.first_step: Write the first-notice questions your claims team always asks.

VD-074.title: Resolve routine account calls
VD-074.what_it_does: The agent handles balance, transaction, card lock, branch and fee questions after secure identity checks. It performs simple actions and passes complex cases on with full context.
VD-074.first_step: Rank your inbound call reasons by volume.

VD-075.title: Book advisor and banker appointments
VD-075.what_it_does: The agent matches the customer's need to the right specialist, books branch or video appointments and syncs calendars. It sends preparation lists and manages rescheduling.
VD-075.first_step: List the specialist types and the questions that route to each.

VD-076.title: Update applicants and chase loan documents
VD-076.what_it_does: Applicants hear at each stage where their application stands, and the agent chases missing documents with checklists and upload links. It books a call with the loan officer when needed.
VD-076.first_step: List the documents applicants most often forget.

VD-077.title: Verify flagged transactions by phone
VD-077.what_it_does: The agent contacts customers about flagged transactions, confirms who they are and records whether each was genuine. It takes card actions under policy and passes confirmed fraud to specialists.
VD-077.first_step: Document your verification steps and the card actions allowed on a call.

VD-078.title: Answer rate and pre-approval enquiries fast
VD-078.what_it_does: The agent replies to rate and pre-approval enquiries within minutes, collecting loan purpose, amount, credit band and timeline. It books a loan officer consultation and follows up with rate shoppers.
VD-078.first_step: Time how long rate enquiries wait for a reply today.

VD-079.title: Chase borrower documents and conditions
VD-079.what_it_does: The agent sends each borrower a checklist with upload links, answers document questions and checks completeness. Your loan system milestone updates automatically.
VD-079.first_step: List the documents borrowers must send for a standard loan.

VD-080.title: Keep pre-approved borrowers warm
VD-080.what_it_does: The agent stays in touch with pre-approved borrowers who have not yet signed a contract, with rate alerts and regular check-ins. It books the loan officer call the moment buying intent returns.
VD-080.first_step: Export pre-approved borrowers with no contract yet.

VD-081.title: Coordinate closing across all parties
VD-081.what_it_does: From clear-to-close the agent confirms signing appointments with borrowers, agents and title, and sends document reminders. It manages last-mile rescheduling so closings do not slip.
VD-081.first_step: Map the people and steps involved in one typical closing.

VD-086.title: Answer parts availability and price calls
VD-086.what_it_does: The agent identifies parts from descriptions, photos or serial numbers and checks live stock and pricing across branches. It quotes lead times and takes orders or hands complex cases to a specialist.
VD-086.first_step: Share the ten parts enquiries your counter answers most.

VD-087.title: Quote fast and chase every open quote
VD-087.what_it_does: Standard RFQs become same-day quotes, and every open quote gets a disciplined follow-up. The agent answers spec questions and records why a quote was lost.
VD-087.first_step: List open quotes and the last time each was followed up.

VD-088.title: Schedule service and maintenance visits
VD-088.what_it_does: The agent collects equipment and fault details, checks technician availability and parts stock and confirms the appointment. It sends the technician's arrival time on the day.
VD-088.first_step: Document how a service call is booked today, step by step.

VD-089.title: Push order and delivery updates
VD-089.what_it_does: Customers get updates at order confirmation, shipment and delivery. The agent answers delivery questions from live carrier data and coordinates pickups and delivery window changes.
VD-089.first_step: Count where-is-my-order calls per week and the carriers involved.

VD-090.title: Turn emailed and chat orders into sales orders
VD-090.what_it_does: The agent reads orders from email, PDFs, WhatsApp and calls, then checks items, pricing, credit and stock in your ERP. Confirmed sales orders are written automatically and exceptions go to your team.
VD-090.first_step: Gather ten recent orders in the different formats customers send.

VD-091.title: Answer did-you-get-my-order calls
VD-091.what_it_does: The agent answers confirmation, status and tracking questions from your ERP and sends confirmations and shipment notices before customers ask. Credit-hold cases go to a person.
VD-091.first_step: Count confirmation calls per week and the answer given most.

VD-092.title: Reach out when reorders are due
VD-092.what_it_does: The agent watches each account's buying cycle and contacts the customer when a reorder window opens. It takes standing and repeat orders, applies contract prices and writes the order to your ERP.
VD-092.first_step: Pick ten accounts with regular cycles and note their usual reorder gap.

VD-093.title: Guide new accounts through onboarding
VD-093.what_it_does: The agent collects business details and credit applications in conversation and chases references and documents. It checks the file is complete before handing the account to sales.
VD-093.first_step: List the documents every new account must provide.

VD-094.title: Update customers on freight status
VD-094.what_it_does: The agent sends pickup, in-transit, delay and delivery notices and answers where-is-my-freight questions from your transport system. Proof of delivery goes out on request.
VD-094.first_step: Count status calls per week and what customers ask in them.

VD-095.title: Replace dispatcher check calls
VD-095.what_it_does: The agent calls drivers and carriers on schedule to get location and arrival time and confirms pickup and delivery appointments. It updates your transport system as it goes.
VD-095.first_step: Time one dispatcher's day to see how much goes on check calls.

VD-096.title: Handle delays and failed deliveries
VD-096.what_it_does: When a shipment hits trouble, the agent contacts the consignee with the reason and a new arrival time. It rebooks failed deliveries, records access notes and coordinates redelivery with the carrier.
VD-096.first_step: List the exception types you handle most and the usual fix.

VD-097.title: Capture spot quote requests
VD-097.what_it_does: The agent pulls lanes, freight class and dates from emails and calls and returns tariff or contract prices within your rules. Complex bids go to your pricing team with complete data.
VD-097.first_step: Collect recent spot quote emails and mark which could use a fixed price.

VD-098.title: Take legal enquiries around the clock
VD-098.what_it_does: The agent answers every call and web enquiry, including nights and weekends, and runs intake questions for each practice area. It does basic conflict checks, books consultations and flags urgent cases for immediate callback.
VD-098.first_step: Write the intake questions for your busiest practice area.

VD-099.title: Follow up online legal leads at once
VD-099.what_it_does: The agent replies to every form, chat and directory lead in under a minute, asks about matter type and urgency and books a consultation against attorney calendars. It keeps following up until engaged or ruled out.
VD-099.first_step: Time how long web leads wait for a response today.

VD-100.title: Confirm consultations and chase intake papers
VD-100.what_it_does: Consultations are confirmed with reminders, and intake forms and case papers are chased before the meeting. No-shows are rebooked so attorneys walk in with a complete file.
VD-100.first_step: List the documents each consultation type needs in advance.

VD-101.title: Answer case status calls
VD-101.what_it_does: The agent reads matter status from your case system and delivers the updates you have approved. It takes messages with context and routes only real legal questions to attorneys.
VD-101.first_step: Count status calls per week and list who normally answers them.

VD-102.title: Chase client documents through busy season
VD-102.what_it_does: Each engagement gets a personal checklist, deadline reminders and an upload link. The agent checks completeness and updates file status in your practice system.
